Subject: Head of Ecommerce – Paula De Francisco

Dear Hiring Team,

I'd like to apply for the Head of Ecommerce role at The Giving Movement.

You're looking for someone who connects trading, acquisition, conversion and retention into one growth engine and owns the numbers. That is the work I've done across marketplace and D2C over the last five years:

- Trading: at Alibaba's Miravia I managed 42 fashion, beauty and fragrance brands to +30% GMV quarter on quarter, and owned the Flash Sales channel against P&L targets, reporting directly to the CEO.
- Acquisition and conversion: in Dubai I run a Shopify D2C store end to end (merchandising, UX, checkout) and its Meta and Google Ads, and built an influencer programme from zero to 25–50 creators per campaign.
- Retention: at Miravia I created the Beauty Club to build customer loyalty, and tracked retention alongside conversion and ROAS.
- Measurement: I read every promotion against a control (SMASH x talabat: +165% daily sales vs +4.7% for the control brand) and built a Claude-based system that automates our KPI reporting.

I'm based in Dubai and lead a team of two. My fashion grounding comes from Inditex, Glovo's Retail vertical and a CUNEF degree specialised in e-commerce and the fashion industry.

My CV is attached. I'd welcome the chance to talk about TGM's next phase of growth.

Best regards,
Paula De Francisco
